text:
maria: Opening a focused thread: we need a clear acceptance plan for the Progressive Segmentation initiative (policy simulator, traffic shadowing, eviction tax, and launch gates). Keep replies short.
theo: We should differentiate two pushes: (1) policy simulation & cost modeling, (2) runtime features: shadowing, soft-evict, and eviction tax billing.
jessica: From product side, customers want a "shadow preview" for migrations so they can see latency/cost impact before cutover. Need UX + API for that.
rajan: Runtime notes: implement a simulator that can run a routing policy graph against historical traces. CLI example: `ri-sim --trace /traces/2026-02-01 --policy policy.json --metrics tail,p99,cost` will output expected p99 and estimated infra multiplier.
toni: Ops: define "eviction tax" = extra infra charge during grace window to cover parallel runs & cache prefill. Recommend default 10% of monthly commitment for 24h window, adjustable per tenant.
amir: Engineering ask: policy DSL must express traffic-shadow(%), soft-evict(duration), eviction-tax(policy), region-coalesce(prefer:list). Example snippet:```policy {id: "seg/v1" selectors: ["tenant:acme"], shadow: 0.1, soft_evict: "12h", eviction_tax: "10%"}```
maria: Draft launch gates suggestion: 1) policy simulator validated on 6 weeks of traces; 2) shadowing in staging with reporting; 3) eviction_tax billing flows defined with finance; 4) soft-evict automation + runbook; 5) customer-facing preview API + one-pager.
theo: Add acceptance metric: simulator-estimated p99 delta vs observed in canary < 15% error. Also require cost-estimate variance <20%.
jessica: I'll draft the preview API contract and the one-pager for sales/legal. Target: include residency/PEERING notes.
rajan: I'll wire the simulator to our telemetry store and run it against three pilot tenants this week. Will post results.
toni: Ops will draft billing annex for eviction_tax and grace-window reconciliation.\mamaria: (typo) maria: Calendar: sync Fri 10am to review simulator outputs and billing annex.
calendarbot: meeting created: "Progressive Segmentation kickoff" Fri 10:00 Zoom link posted.
maria: Thanks team. If nobody objects, I'll make a PRD stub and assign owners.
